title: Lore-Forge story chapter header (story/NN-slug.md front matter), schema version 1
description: YAML header of a manuscript chapter. The Markdown prose follows the header. A file without a header is read too: the title comes from the file name, the order from its NN- prefix.

date.description: Optional in-world date the chapter is set at, e.g. "1920" or "12.03.1920" or "~200 OK".

pov.description: Optional: whose point of view the chapter is told from, a character by id or name.

status.description: Optional: how far the chapter is. Without it, a chapter counts as an idea while it has no text and as a draft once it has.

summary.description: Optional: what happens in the chapter, in a line or two, shown on its card on the planning board.

era.description: Optional era code, kept as an extra key.

year.description: Optional year, kept as an extra key.
